annotate_group_measure.meaning: Append a measure for the complete key group to every original row. Choose min, max or lower_median of a signed integer field, or count_equal of exact text matching the supplied value. For numeric measures pass an empty value. Initial row order and positions survive.

match_intervals.meaning: Match half-open signed integer intervals within the chosen key. Return left and right IDs sorted by pair, with the left source position. overlap emits each pair once, smaller ID first; touches emits predecessor then successor; contains emits enclosing then enclosed and excludes equal endpoints. IDs identify rows within each key.
